            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.TelephoneValidation"
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            exactly 4 digits and valid for the owner's city, whose region fixes
            the allowed range (Sydney/NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne/VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane/QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned unchanged when given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. Once set it is stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional. When present it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the registrationDate. Stored and returned unchanged.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only hint, supplied on create, declaring that this owner
            deliberately lives in the same household as an existing owner (same
            last name and address). Retained for backward compatibility and has
            no effect: duplicate detection now uses the combined identityKey, so
            members of the same household with different telephones are always
            allowed. Not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                A stable code assigned when the owner is created, formatted
                '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from
                the postcode (or 'UNKNOWN' when no region can be derived) and
                HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name. It
                carries no sequence number.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by all owners who live in the same
                household (same last name and address, compared case-insensitively
                with collapsed whitespace). Owners created with 'sharesHousehold'
                set to true share this value with the existing household member.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3A7F1C9B2E4D'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was
                created, shared the same first name and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and returned unchanged.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                A derived membership identifier formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                A derived numeric membership level from 1 to 3, assigned on
                create: starting at 1, add 1 when an email is present and add 1
                when namesakeCount is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for
                tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, taken from the REGION segment
                of the customerCode (the text before its first '-'), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the owner has no customer code.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                A warning flag set when more than 80 owners have already been
                created on this owner's registration day. Assigned on create and
                returned unchanged.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The preferred channel for contacting the owner, derived from
                whether an email is present: 'EMAIL' when an email is present,
                otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived key through which all duplicate detection is
                expressed, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId'
                (the email segment is empty when no email is present). Two owners
                are the same identity only when their whole identity keys are
                equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|HH-3A7F1C9B2E4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits
                contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate computed against
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate is
                set.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

          minimum: 0

          minimum: 1
          example: 5

          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2

## Summary

I implemented the soft-match "possible duplicate" rule for owner creation. When a new owner isn't a hard duplicate (which is still rejected on a reused telephone) but shares an existing owner's `lastName` (case-insensitive) and `postcode` with a *different* telephone, the owner is still created and now carries `possibleDuplicate: true` with `possibleDuplicateOf` set to the matching owner's id; otherwise `possibleDuplicate` is `false`.

Changes:
- **`model/Owner.java`** — added persisted `possibleDuplicate` (Boolean) and `possibleDuplicateOf` (Integer) fields with getters/setters.
- **`service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`** — added `assignPossibleDuplicate(owner)`, invoked only on create (after the hard-duplicate identity check). It finds an existing owner matching normalized lastName + postcode with a differing normalized telephone, picking the lowest id when several match, and sets the two fields accordingly (false / null when none).
- **`mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — mapped the new fields; `possibleDuplicate` goes through a formatter that coerces null→false so the response always carries an explicit boolean (mirroring `bulkSignupWarning`); `possibleDuplicateOf` maps by name.
- **`resources/openapi.yml`** — added the two read-only properties to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` exposes them.
- **`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`** — added `possible_duplicate` / `possible_duplicate_of` columns.

Test result: `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0` — `BUILD SUCCESS`. The acceptance test `coreFlagsPossibleDuplicate` (the only test in the suite) passes.

One note: the acceptance base references a soft-delete convention ("flagged deleted, so the create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks ignore it"), but the current `Owner` entity has no deleted flag and no test exercises it here, so the new soft-match considers all existing owners — consistent with how the existing identity/capacity checks already behave.
